descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Every song is a round. Every beat is a punch.

BeatDown puts you toe-to-toe with an opponent who fights to the music. Read the cues, dodge the swing, and hit back on the beat. Chain your hits to build your multiplier, then end the song with a finisher combo that sends your opponent flying.

## Fight to the music
Targets and dodges land on the beat of every track. The harder you swing, the bigger the hit, from a weak **PFFT** to a full **KAPOW**.

## Arenas that move with the song
Every arena reacts to the beat:

- A castle gate
- A pirate deck under cannon fire
- A nightclub
- A collapsing construction platform
- A snowy Christmas yard
- The roof of a big rig in a highway chase

**More arenas are on the way.**

## Pick your fighter
Choose your opponent and your own body from a roster of fighters.

## 50+ original songs
Browse a library of original songs across many genres. Search, filter, and preview before you fight.

## Play your way
- Multiple difficulty levels
- Roomscale or Stationary play
- Grades, high scores, and a results screen after every fight

**Put your gloves up. The beat is about to drop.**
